_comment: Cards that exist only for the skip-draw-step test (tests/unit/turn/test_skip_draw_step.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_necro_skip` is Necropotence's first line on its own. `t_conditional_skip` carries the same static behind an `as long as` clause, so the test can pin that the condition is actually asked -- a player-wide static whose condition is dropped is the silent over-grant `_active_player_statics` exists to stop.
